summary: Turns the FM-1 into a programmable USB keyboard and macro pad, configured with Vial or an on-device editor. It makes no sound, and the author says it is AI-written and not fully tested by hand.
features: Every key, button and the four knobs can send any key or shortcut
Media keys and mouse movement, buttons and wheel
Five QMK-style layers with layer-tap, mod-tap and one-shot modifiers
Macros, tap dance and combos, written in Vial
On-device editor, live on-screen legend and per-key light styles
Stays a USB-MIDI device, so firmware installers still work
